title: Zero trust and shadow IT: framework mapping
frameworks: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture and NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0

ZT-01: All devices, applications and SaaS tools in use are inventoried, including ones found through discovery.
Asset and SaaS inventory with discovery source
ZT-02: Access is granted per request based on identity, with no implicit trust from network location.
Access policy and identity provider conditional access rules
ZT-03: New cloud and SaaS services go through security and vendor review before use.
SaaS approval records and vendor reviews
ZT-04: Installation and use of unapproved software is prevented or detected.
Allowlist or app control policy and detection reports
ZT-05: Device health and compliance are checked as a condition of access.
Device compliance policy and access denial logs
ZT-06: Networks and workloads are segmented so access is limited to what is needed.

rows: Inventory of information and other associated assets
Logical access security software, infrastructure and architectures
Protect: identity management, authentication and access control
Information security for use of cloud services
Assesses and manages risks from vendors and business partners
Business associate contracts and other arrangements
Prevent or detect unauthorised or malicious software
Logical access security measures against threats from outside system boundaries
Microsegmentation is one of the deployment approaches it describes.
